test_linear_dynamic_pooling_batcher: test the LinearDynamicPoolingBatcher with a BatcherSchedulerConfig to verify linear batch size scaling across epochs
test_exponential_dynamic_pooling_batcher: test the ExponentialDynamicPoolingBatcher with an ExponentialBatcherSchedulerConfig to verify exponential batch size growth using gamma
test_batch_size_clamping: test that ExponentialDynamicPoolingBatcher clamps batch size to dataset length when computed size exceeds available data
test_scheduler_end_behavior: test that the exponential scheduler reaches the configured end_batch_size after the epoch_period is exceeded
test_step_size_configuration: test that the step_size parameter controls how often the batch size increases across training epochs
